transcript.text: Hello, I'm here to help you get ready for your appointment. Could you tell me what has been bothering you?
It's my right knee, doctor. It's been aching and it's getting worse — it's really slowing me down now.
When did you first notice it?
Oh, it's been going on a while back now — I couldn't tell you exactly when it started.
Is there anything that makes it better or worse?
It's worse going down the stairs, and after I've been walking for a bit. Resting helps settle it.
How would you describe the feeling in your own words?
It's a deep, grinding sort of ache, and the knee feels stiff in the mornings — though it eases off after a little while.
Where exactly do you feel it, and does it spread anywhere?
It's on the inner side of the right knee, and no, it doesn't travel down my leg.
On a scale from 0 to 10, where 10 is the worst, how bad is it?
It's not too bad on a good day, but on the bad days it's quite sore — it really stops me doing things.
Is it there all the time, or does it come and go?
It comes and goes — some days it's fine, other days it flares up.
Has anything else been bothering you along with this?
The knee sometimes puffs up a bit by the evening, but there's no redness or fever, and it's never locked on me.
Do you see a doctor regularly for any health condition?
Yes, I've got a few things — I've had diabetes for a long while, and I had a stent put in a heart artery some years back.
Which medicines do you take regularly, including any new ones?
Oh, a few tablets — one for the diabetes, and some others for my heart and cholesterol. I can never remember all the names.
Are you allergic to any medicines?
Yes, there's one antibiotic that gives me a rash — I can't recall the name of it offhand.
Has this changed what you can do around the house or outside?
Yes, it's made a difference — I have to go down the stairs one step at a time now, holding on to the rail.
Is there anything about this that worries you?
I'd like something stronger for the pain, to be honest. And I've been wondering — do you think I might end up needing a knee replacement?
Thank you, that is very helpful. I have put together a short summary of what you told me. Please read it and tell me if anything should be corrected before it goes to your doctor.
